description.zh: 这些帧显示门框或门洞边缘的近景，说明机器人转向并靠近门口，但未显示已跨过门槛。
description.en: These frames show close views of a door/window frame edge, indicating that the robot turns toward and approaches the doorway, but they do not show crossing the threshold.

description.zh: 这些帧显示透过门洞看向相邻空间，右侧墙内有一幅带框画；视角位于门槛附近或门槛前。
description.en: These frames show a view through the doorway into the adjacent space with one framed artwork on the right wall; the viewpoint is at or just before the threshold.

semantic_progress.zh: 机器人已从带洗手池和镜子的室内移动到门洞前，途中靠近过门框或门洞边缘；透过门洞可见相邻空间，右侧墙上有一幅带框画。尚未确认已穿门进入目标房间，也未确认四幅挂画墙、右侧高盆栽、餐区及右侧竹帘大窗。
semantic_progress.en: The robot has moved from the washroom area with a sink and mirror to the doorway, having approached the door/window frame or doorway edge on the way; through the doorway an adjacent space is visible with one framed artwork on the right wall. It is not yet confirmed that the robot has crossed into the target room, nor have the four-artwork wall, tall potted plant on the right, dining area, or large bamboo-blind window on the right been confirmed.

uncertainties.zh: 到 B 时是否已经跨过门槛进入房间尚不明确。
uncertainties.en: It is not clear whether the robot has crossed the threshold into the room by B.

uncertainties.zh: 门洞内右侧只见到一幅带框画，无法确认它是否属于任务所述的四幅挂画墙。
uncertainties.en: Only one framed artwork is visible on the right beyond the doorway, so it cannot be confirmed whether it belongs to the instructed four-artwork wall.

uncertainties.zh: 尚未看到高盆栽、餐桌和竹帘大窗，无法核对其后的空间关系。
uncertainties.en: The tall potted plant, dining table, and large bamboo-blind window have not been seen, so their subsequent spatial relationships cannot be verified.

segment_summary.zh: 本段从洗手池和镜子旁开始，先靠近门框或门洞边缘，又回到洗手池附近，最后移动到门洞前。到 B 时，可透过门洞看到相邻空间，右侧墙内有一幅带框画；但没有看到明确穿过门洞进入房间的连续证据。
segment_summary.en: This segment starts near the sink and mirror, approaches a door/window frame or doorway edge, returns near the sink, and finally moves to the doorway. At B, the view through the doorway shows an adjacent space with one framed artwork on the right wall; there is no clear continuous evidence of crossing the threshold into the room.

reason.zh: 画面显示机器人在带洗手池和镜子的室内调整朝向并靠近门洞，最后停在门洞前；门洞内右侧可见带框画，与任务所述挂画墙在右侧的方向不冲突。穿门进入、四幅挂画墙、右侧高盆栽、餐区及竹帘大窗仍未确认。
reason.en: The frames show the robot in the washroom area with a sink and mirror, reorienting and moving toward the doorway, then stopping at the doorway; a framed artwork is visible on the right beyond it, which is not in conflict with the instructed right-side artwork wall. Entry through the doorway, the four-artwork wall, the tall potted plant on the right, the dining area, and the bamboo-blind window remain unconfirmed.

instruction_evidence.quote_en: Go through the doorway and enter the room
keeping the wall with four framed artworks on your right
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 让挂有四幅带框画的墙保持在你的右侧

instruction_evidence.quote_en: stop in front of the window
